mentions.name: Actualize This
mentions.description: A card game that gamifies Maslow's hierarchy of needs, built with no imported libraries or dependencies. Each player drafts cards representing ways to spend limited time to gather resources (wisdom, gold, and virtue) and complete a personal player board (their hierarchy of needs), with the goal of reaching self-actualization before other players. An alternate win path lets players win without self-actualization by completing more hidden quests, which can only be discarded by the "therapy session" card. The project is being crowdfunded/followed on Gamefound.
